summary: This directory centralizes error handling and lifecycle tracking for the library. It provides structured error types and contextual metadata specifically tailored to the distinct phases of concept generation and document building processes.
responsibilities: Define custom error classes for internal system failures
Provide contextual metadata for tracking error origins
Categorize errors by lifecycle or processing phase
relationships: Error classes utilize context interfaces to carry diagnostic information about the specific failure state.
Phase types define the discrete stages of operations where errors are monitored and reported.
designDecisions: Use of specialized error subclasses to encapsulate domain-specific failures
Separation of error metadata into context interfaces to ensure type safety
Standardized structure for representing state-specific error details
